{{Top|leg}}
The '''Golden Cochlea''' was a restaurant in the city of [[Hedrett]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], that operated during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It's head chef was called [[Maegyn]] and he would often place orders with [[Mothven Star Trading]], to acquire herbs and spices for the restaurant.
